name: Example report
description: Select the high-priority items of an items file, confirm the selection, summarise it and render a markdown report. Deterministic: no model call, no network.
examples: run the example report workflow on an items file

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: Path of a JSON items file: an array of objects with the fields id, title and priority.

steps.prompt: These items were selected from ${inputs.source}: ${steps.select.outputs.item_ids}. Proceed with the report?
